corrections.text: The article reports 7,065 contributors, about 15,000 GitHub stars and over 6,800 forks from the CNCF announcement post, and says "The project lists 7,065 contributors." Those figures appear in the post's Notable Milestones list, which says they span two GitHub organizations. The CNCF project page the article also cites shows different LFX Insights figures: 5,851 total contributors, 871 contributing organizations, 3,529 GitHub stars and 2,201 forks. Neither page explains the difference.
